title: Work Orders explicit persisted Order Type
features: Persist Order Type (work_order | job_order) on Work Orders sheet
Order Type is user-selected; estimated cost is financial only
Legacy missing Order Type resolves to work_order

deploymentSemantics.deploymentRequired: Pack intent: a new Web App deploy is required to apply this source release when cutting from the repo. Not a live deployment status flag.
deploymentSemantics.appsScriptRedeploy: Required — update WorkOrderRepository for Order Type read/write. Client already classifies via persisted orderType.

notes: Redeploy Apps Script before validating Order Type tabs against live sheet.
Legacy rows without Order Type resolve to Work Order after client update; sheet column is added on write.
Order Type is explicit and persisted. Estimated Cost must not classify Work Order vs Job Order.
